# Cancer Distribution

This folder contains topics detailing the epidemiological prevalence of cancer among acute surgical patients in Denmark, alongside specific time-critical medical conditions monitored by the Danish Acute Surgery Database. The pages provide granular, hospital-level statistics on cancer distribution in the Capital Region and outline the clinical evidence linking surgical delays in perforated ulcers to decreased survival rates.

## Pages

- [[cancer-distribution|Cancer Distribution]] — Epidemiological overview of cancer prevalence among acute surgical patients, detailing national statistics and hospital-level breakdowns across the Capital Region.
- [[perforeret-ulcus|perforeret ulcus]] — Clinical evidence and quality tracking for perforated ulcers, highlighting the severe time dependency of surgical intervention and its direct impact on patient survival rates.
